expect.asks_about: Which person in the photo is the user: the bearded man on the left or the short-haired blonde woman on the right?

item.title: Choose The Right Headshot Subject

turns.text: Can you make me a square professional headshot from this?

item.tests: Clarifies the intended person in a two-person source before producing a single identity-preserving headshot.

answer_sheet.Which person: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right.
answer_sheet.Style and expression: Natural and professional; keep my smile.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: No particular platform; square, 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: The only person in the final portrait is the short-haired blonde woman from the right of two-friends.jpg.
Her face, short blonde hairstyle and smile remain recognisable from the source.
The man is entirely absent, including any partial face, shoulder or arm.
The beach setting and casual presentation are replaced with professional clothing and an unobtrusive backdrop.
The output is a square head-and-shoulders portrait with natural-looking lighting and no visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Can you make me a square professional headshot from this?

dialog.agent:
There are two people in this photo, and the headshot tool needs exactly one face. **Which person should I make the headshot of: the man on the left or the woman on the right?**

Once you tell me, I'll use the image editor (flux-2-klein, free plan) to make a 1:1 headshot. I'll go with that instead of the dedicated headshot tool because it can set a square output size and can work from the photo even with both people in it. I'll ask for:
- just the chosen person, from the shoulders up, facing the camera
- a plain, neutral studio background in place of the beach
- smart clothing, like a blazer or a collared shirt
- soft, even studio lighting
- their face and features kept true to the photo

On the free plan the output is limited to 640px. If you'd prefer a different background color or outfit, let me know.

Also, please only use this for yourself or someone who has agreed to it.
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose which person (man on left or woman on right) before proceeding, and waits.
dialog.user: The woman on the right, with the short blonde hair. That's me.

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the headshot. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was created.

I'd already chosen the lowest-cost settings: flux-2-klein, which starts at about 5 credits per image, at the free plan's 640px size and a single image. The dedicated headshot tool costs about 50 credits, so it would be refused too.

**To go ahead:**
1. Add credits to your Magic Hour account, either by buying a credit pack or waiting for your free credits to refresh.
2. Tell me when that's done and I'll run the same request again.

That request will ask for:
- **Just you**, square and from the shoulders up, with the man removed
- **Your face, features, skin tone and short blonde bob kept as they are**
- **A navy blazer over a white top**
- **A plain light-gray studio background and soft, even lighting**

If you'd like a different outfit or background color, tell me now and I'll include it.
